newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates mixed.
newsitem.headline: One-month to one-year Saudi t-bill rates mixed.

text.p: Yields were mixed on one-month to one-year Saudi treasury bills worth two billion riyals offered by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (SAMA) on Tuesday, bankers said.
The yield on 28-day bills, maturing on May 22, was steady at 5.6497 percent and the rate on 91-day bills, maturing on July 24, fell to 5.7300 percent from 5.7380 two weeks ago.
The yield on 182-day bills, maturing on October 23, climbed to 5.9453 percent from 5.9207. The 364-day bills, maturing on April 23, 1998 yielded 6.3566 from 6.2691 two weeks ago.
SAMA, the kingdom's central bank, did not offer bills last week because of a week-long holiday marking Eid al-Adha.
One-month interbank deposits were quoted at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent, three months were at 5-7/8, 3/4 percent, six months were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year funds were put at 6-1/2, 3/8 percent.
